notes.content:
• Added the following translations:

notes.title: v1.0.8 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where act select sometimes caused camera view problems.
Fixed a bug with mouse wheel speed issues when zooming in & out.
Fixed a camera view bug at the Flower Sea Terminal.
Removed a line of unclear dialogue.
Slightly adjusted the location of the healing item in the boss fight.
Slightly adjusted the positions of some images in the boss fight.
Fixed text overlap issues in certain languages.
(Again) attempted to fix the bug where the second letter puzzle could not be correctly solved.
(Again) attempted to fix the bug where the paper boat would become invisible during certain cutscenes.

notes.title: v1.0.71 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where pressing keys during cutscenes at the exit of the Block Maze would allow player move.
Fixed a bug where a specific spot during the boss fight unexpectedly caused damage.
Fixed a bug where a certain area in the Block Box allowed clipping.
Fixed a bug where music did not play in Ride's End.
Fixed a bug where NPCs occasionally triggered sound effects even when they had no dialogue.
Fixed a bug related to the Voucher Tycoon and Strongest Paper achievements when switching steam account.
Fixed a bug where the screen would occasionally glitch after conversations in the Wheel of Fortune corridor.
Fixed a bug where certain sound effects were bugged after finding Demetria in the Wheel of Fortune level.
Fixed several translation errors in Russian localization.
Added tutorial prompts for movement at the beginning.
Changed the order in which puzzle signs appear in Block Box.
Improved guidance for the Teddy's head in Block Box.
Optimized performance issues caused by an excessive number of moths in Park Train.
Attempted to fix a bug where the second letter puzzle could not be correctly solved.
Attempted to fix a bug where the player could become undead under certain circumstances.

notes.title: Illusion Carnival Chapter 1 is officially released for free!
notes.content:
New content includes character profiles, achievements, gallery art, and save & load functionality, all added to enhance the immersive amusement park adventure.
Thank you all for your bug testing and support during the beta test phase. I hope the official release provides a more complete and enjoyable experience for all players!
Enjoy your journey to Confettia!

Demo version is now deactivated. Due to having the same length in main content, the official version will inherit the save file from demo.

Here are the detailed update notes:

• Italian Localization implemented
• Added "Act Select" option
	○ Enables level selection and save/load functionality
• Added "Troupe" option
	○ View newly added 2.5D character portraits, profiles, and stills for 6 characters
• Added "Gallery" option
	○ Includes concept art, design sketches, fan arts, and an animated short set in the same universe as this game
• Added 12 achievements
• Added an easter egg about moths
• Added 3 cotton to investigate in the candy puzzle
• Added a warning when Exeunt is clicked
• Added a paper plane appearance to the cursor
• Fixed a bug where player would sometimes stay in paper boat or invisible form
• Fixed a bug where signs would get overlapping on the main menu
• Fixed a bug where signs would sometimes fly away
• Fixed a bug where teleport positions are incorrect
• Fixed a bug where players could receive an extra gingerbread in Block Box
• Fixed a bug where Demetria would freeze and not speak when falling out of the Wheel of Fortune level
• Fixed a bug where continuous dashing at the beginning of the Endless Hallway would cause freezing
• Fixed a bug where character names would display in Chinese in certain languages
• Changed puzzle input method from text entry to letter/number locks
• Adjusted camera angles in the Park Train scene
• Adjusted name input validation
• Adjusted camera shake sensitivity
• Adjusted hints for candy and letter puzzles
• Optimized D-pad navigation for controller
